item.title: MQTT Integration
item.description:
Overview

The MQTT Integration page lets you configure MQTT streaming for your organization and manage the API keys that MQTT clients use to connect.

Roles

MQTT Integration is available to the Manager role only.

To open the page, select Organization in the top navigation, then select Integrations and MQTT.

Studio supports one MQTT subscription integration per organization. The page shows its status, description, broker URL, TLS port, subscription ID, and linked API keys.
